newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Brown favours 50% top tax rate - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Brown favours 50% top tax rate - paper.

text.p: The Times newspaper reported that Gordon Brown, shadow finance minister for Britain's opposition Labour party, favoured raising the top rate of income tax to 50 percent from 40 percent for people earning more than 100,000 stg a year.

It said his views, made known at a meeting of Labour's shadow cabinet on Wednesday, displeased some frontbenchers who would prefer a lower threshold for a higher tax rate in order to generate extra revenue for spending on health and education.
Labour has avoided detailed pronouncements on what it would do about taxes if it wins an election due by next May.
But party leader Tony Blair has said he has no plans to raise the top rate of tax.
